# Reference consumer verification-and-review workflow, verified end to end in a
# fresh repository (GitHub-hosted runners, record-transport: job-output, provenance:
# summary). Save as .github/workflows/ci.yml. The bootstrap is referenced as
# gaulatti/clouseau/scripts/resolve@main on purpose: the engine is resolved from protected
# main at run time, so a commit pin on the bootstrap adds little and only goes stale. Do not
# replace @main with a tag, another branch or a fork. The job named "verify" and its
# step names must match "verification" in .github/clouseau.json; adapt the install and
# test steps to your stack. Secrets (all optional, see docs/quickstart.md):
# DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, TYPESAFE_API_KEY, CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN.
name: CI
run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('Verify PR #{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) ||
      inputs.check_author && 'Verify repair author' ||
      format('PR review ({0})', github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || inputs.pull_request || github.ref_name) }}
on:
  push:
    branches: ['policy-install/**']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pull_request:
        description: PR number to reassess without executing contributor code; empty runs verification
        type: string
        required: false
      check_author:
        description: Inspect existing repair author identity and repository access without writing or deploying
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || inputs.pull_request || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  resolve-clouseau:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.engine.outputs.sha }}
      digest: ${{ steps.engine.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - id: engine
        uses: gaulatti/clouseau/scripts/resolve@main
        with:
          provenance: summary

  # Optional: skip the checks a valid local receipt already attests (docs/local-review.md, "Receipt-attested verification").
  # Any other outcome, including an error here, leaves `attested` unset and `verify` runs every check.
  attested:
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      attested: ${{ steps.decide.outputs.attested }}
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Decide whether a local receipt attests the verification
        id: decide
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: attested
          config: .github/clouseau.json

  verify:
    # Schedule the job so GitHub resolves its name, including metadata events.
    # Step guards keep those events from running contributor code.
    name: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == '' && !inputs.check_author)) && 'verify' || 'metadata-only' }}
    needs: [resolve-clouseau, attested]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        # `attested` is 'true' only for a pull request whose receipt attests this exact head; then every step is skipped and the
        # engine accepts the skipped required steps because it verifies the same receipt itself.
        if: &verify-code >-
          (github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == '' && !inputs.check_author)) &&
          needs.attested.outputs.attested != 'true'
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: *verify-code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify the frozen Clouseau engine
        if: *verify-code
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: verify-engine
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: *verify-code
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Select accepted verification recipe
        if: *verify-code
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          if test -n "$BASE_SHA" && git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:.clouseau-local.json" 2>/dev/null; then
            git show "$BASE_SHA:.clouseau-local.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/clouseau-coverage.json"
          else
            cp .clouseau-local.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/clouseau-coverage.json"
          fi
      - name: Install verification dependencies
        if: *verify-code
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Run tests and measure native coverage
        if: *verify-code
        run: npm run test:coverage
      - name: Enforce 100% line and branch coverage
        if: *verify-code
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: coverage
          coverage-config: ${{ runner.temp }}/clouseau-coverage.json

  assess-intent:
    if: &review-event >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 70
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    outputs:
      assessment: ${{ steps.local-review.outputs.assessment || steps.assess.outputs.assessment }}
      review-record: ${{ steps.local-review.outputs.review-record || steps.assess.outputs.review-record }}
      number: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
      # 'true' only when the receipt-only route found the receipt unusable; the only data that leaves this job towards assess-hosted
      hosted: ${{ steps.fallback.outputs.hosted }}
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - name: Verify the owner-authorized frozen reviewer installation
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        id: install
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const match = context.ref.match(/^refs\/heads\/policy-install\/pr-([1-9][0-9]*)$/);
            if (context.actor !== context.repo.owner || !/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(context.sha) || !match) {
              throw new Error('Reviewer installation requires the repository owner and a ready PR number');
            }
            const pull_number = Number(match[1]);
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pull_number)) throw new Error('Invalid installation PR number');
            const {data: pr} = await github.rest.pulls.get({...context.repo, pull_number});
            if (pr.state !== 'open' || pr.draft || pr.base.ref !== 'main' ||
                pr.user.login !== context.repo.owner || pr.head.sha !== context.sha ||
                pr.head.repo?.full_name !== `${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}`) {
              throw new Error('Installation requires the owner-authored same-repository PR at this exact workflow revision');
            }
            const comments = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listComments,
              {...context.repo, issue_number: pull_number, per_page: 100});
            if (!comments.some(comment => comment.user?.type === 'User' && comment.user.login === context.repo.owner &&
                comment.body.trim() === `/approve-intent ${context.sha}`)) {
              throw new Error('Installation requires owner intent confirmation at this exact revision');
            }
            core.setOutput('number', String(pull_number));
      # Never load the controller or its configuration from the PR.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Wait for tests and exact coverage
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          REQUESTED_PR: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
        with:
          script: |
            const path = require('node:path');
            const root = path.resolve('.clouseau-ci');
            const config = require(path.join(root, 'src/config.cjs')).loadConfig('.github/clouseau.json');
            const policy = require(path.join(root, 'src/policy.cjs')).createPolicy(config, {engine: require(path.join(root, 'src/central-version.cjs')).environmentEngine()});
            const number = context.payload.pull_request?.number || Number(process.env.REQUESTED_PR);
            for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 120; attempt++) {
              const {data: pr} = await github.rest.pulls.get({...context.repo, pull_number: number});
              const expected = context.payload.pull_request?.head.sha || context.sha;
              if (pr.state !== 'open' || pr.draft || pr.head.sha !== expected) {
                throw new Error('PR closed, became draft, or changed while verification was pending');
              }
              const result = await policy.technicalRun(github, context.repo, pr);
              if (result.failure) throw new Error(result.failure);
              if (!result.pending) { core.info(`Verified PR CI: ${result.url}. Clouseau acceptance can now start.`); return; }
              core.info('Waiting for independent verification and exact coverage. No AI request has been made.');
              await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 15000));
            }
            throw new Error('PR verification did not complete within 30 minutes');
      - name: Select authenticated local review or the installed CI reviewer
        id: review-route
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            core.setOutput('local', String((context.payload.pull_request?.body || '').includes('clouseau-local-review:v1')));
      - name: Verify authenticated local review without AI credentials
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local == 'true'
        id: local-review
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: verify-local
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
      - name: Hand an unusable receipt to the separate hosted review
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local == 'true'
        id: fallback
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          ASSESSMENT: ${{ steps.local-review.outputs.assessment }}
        with:
          script: |
            const assessment = JSON.parse(process.env.ASSESSMENT);
            core.setOutput('hosted', String(assessment.decision === 'review_incomplete' && assessment.cause === 'local_receipt_unusable'));
      - name: Review unstamped PR through the installed CI AI reviewer
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local != 'true'
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        id: assess
        with:
          operation: assess
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
          provider-key: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          typesafe-key: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}

  # Runs in this same workflow run only when the receipt-only job above found the receipt unusable. This is
  # the only job that holds the provider secrets for a PR that carries a receipt marker, and it never reads the
  # receipt (ignore-receipt) or any value derived from it: it receives just the PR number and the frozen engine.
  assess-hosted:
    if: needs.assess-intent.outputs.hosted == 'true'
    needs: [assess-intent, resolve-clouseau]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 70
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    outputs:
      assessment: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.assessment }}
      review-record: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.review-record }}
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      # Never load the controller or its configuration from the PR.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Review the change through the installed CI AI reviewer, ignoring the receipt
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        id: assess
        with:
          operation: assess
          ignore-receipt: 'true'
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
          provider-key: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          typesafe-key: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}

  approve-and-merge:
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) || (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))) && 'approve-and-merge' || 'metadata-only-approval' }}
    needs: [assess-intent, assess-hosted, resolve-clouseau]
    # Always resolve the job name; only trusted, ready PR events run its steps.
    # A failed assessment must still fail the required native approval check.
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    concurrency:
      group: pr-approval-${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number || github.run_id }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - name: Require a completed assessment
        if: >-
          ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
          (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))) &&
          (needs.assess-intent.result != 'success' || contains(fromJSON('["failure","cancelled"]'), needs.assess-hosted.result))
        run: exit 1
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: *review-event
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: *review-event
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - if: *review-event
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: gate
          record-transport: job-output
          # Exactly one acceptance record per head: the hosted review's when it ran, otherwise the receipt-only job's.
          review-record: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.review-record || needs.assess-intent.outputs.review-record }}
          pull-request: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number }}
          native-gate: 'true'
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}

  apply-repair:
    needs: [assess-intent, assess-hosted, approve-and-merge, resolve-clouseau]
    if: >-
      always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      needs.assess-intent.result == 'success' && contains(fromJSON('["success","skipped"]'), needs.assess-hosted.result) &&
      needs.approve-and-merge.result == 'failure' &&
      fromJSON(needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment).repair_digest != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: read
    concurrency:
      group: pr-approval-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: repair
          record-transport: job-output
          review-record: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.review-record || needs.assess-intent.outputs.review-record }}
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}
          repair-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}

  finalize-merge:
    needs: [assess-intent, assess-hosted, approve-and-merge, resolve-clouseau]
    if: *review-event
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: finalize
          pull-request: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number }}
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}

  request-reassessment:
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.issue.pull_request && (startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/approve-intent ') || startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/hosted-review '))) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request != '' && !inputs.check_author)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: request-reassessment
          pull-request: ${{ inputs.pull_request }}

  check-author:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.check_author
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Verify independent repair author without writing
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const {data: user} = await github.rest.users.getAuthenticated();
            const {data: repository} = await github.rest.repos.get(context.repo);
            if (user.login === 'github-actions[bot]' || !repository.permissions?.push) {
              throw new Error('Repair requires an independent author with Contents write access');
            }
            core.info(`Independent repair author ${user.login} can access ${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}. No write or deployment was made.`);

+#### Manual hosted review (opt-in)
+
+The protected top-level `hosted_review` in `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch says whether the CI AI review of a pull
+request with no usable receipt starts by itself:
+
+| `hosted_review` | No usable receipt (absent, expired or otherwise unusable) |
+| --- | --- |
+| absent or `"automatic"` | today's behavior: the CI AI review runs (optional mode), or `local_receipt_required` (required mode) |
+| `"manual"` | `review_incomplete`, cause `hosted_review_manual`, no provider call, until a maintainer requests the review |
+
+The request reaches the engine only through the repository workflow: its `issue_comment` condition must start a run for
+`/hosted-review ` comments, as `examples/consumer-ci.yml` does. The engine never sees a comment that starts no run, so it
+cannot detect a workflow without that trigger; the hold notice therefore names the missing condition as its last step. A
+consumer that sets `hosted_review: "manual"` adds the condition in the same change.
+
+The request is a comment `/hosted-review <head sha>` on the pull request, validated as `/approve-intent` is: the exact current
+head, a real user (not a bot), write permission or higher, and re-read by the engine itself from the pull request's comments.
+How the run was started never matters, only such a comment. With a valid request the run proceeds as `"automatic"` would; a
+request for an older head, from a reader or from a bot is ignored. A valid receipt is used whatever the setting, and a
+repository in `required` mode keeps `local_receipt_required`. The receipt-only job still holds no provider secret: in manual
+mode it returns `local_receipt_unusable` only when a valid request exists, so the reference workflow's hosted fallback below
+starts exactly then, and the hosted job checks the request again. In the reference workflow (`examples/consumer-ci.yml`) a
+`/hosted-review ` comment starts the reassessment the same way `/approve-intent ` does (the engine's `request-reassessment`
+accepts an exact-head `/hosted-review` from a maintainer as it accepts `/approve-intent`); a consumer carrying an older copy adds
+`|| startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/hosted-review ')` to its `request-reassessment` job condition.
+

evidence.quote:
| `source` | Signed sources, file inventory or diff differ from the pull request (including a changed lockfile summary) |
| `record` | The record, its digest, history, chunked structure or claimed decision is inconsistent or incomplete |
| `engine` | Produced by a different engine revision than the protected one (both short ids are named) |
| `not_passing` | The review it records did not pass |
| `settings` | The protected chunked review configuration is invalid, so the receipt cannot be checked |
| `untested`, `integrity`, `completeness` | Its evidence does not meet hosted approval's affirmative-evidence rule; the rule and, where it applies, the files are named |

Two more classes are only ever shown when no receipt can be used at all:
`absent` (the description carries no marker) and `unread` (a hosted fallback run
does not read receipts). Repositories in `required` mode have no hosted review to
fall back to. The notice then says `This repository requires a valid receipt, so
nothing is approved until you do the following.` and the outcome is
`local_receipt_required`; no provider call is made. On the receipt-only route
(`local_receipt_unusable`) the reason itself carries the cause sentence. While tests are pending or failing, an ignored receipt behaves exactly like
an unstamped change (the pending or blocked result carries the notice).

#### Manual hosted review (opt-in)

The protected top-level `hosted_review` in `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch says whether the CI AI review of a pull
request with no usable receipt starts by itself:

| `hosted_review` | No usable receipt (absent, expired or otherwise unusable) |
| --- | --- |
| absent or `"automatic"` | today's behavior: the CI AI review runs (optional mode), or `local_receipt_required` (required mode) |
| `"manual"` | `review_incomplete`, cause `hosted_review_manual`, no provider call, until a maintainer requests the review |

The request reaches the engine only through the repository workflow: its `issue_comment` condition must start a run for
`/hosted-review ` comments, as `examples/consumer-ci.yml` does. The engine never sees a comment that starts no run, so it
cannot detect a workflow without that trigger; the hold notice therefore names the missing condition as its last step. A
consumer that sets `hosted_review: "manual"` adds the condition in the same change.

The request is a comment `/hosted-review <head sha>` on the pull request, validated as `/approve-intent` is: the exact current
head, a real user (not a bot), write permission or higher, and re-read by the engine itself from the pull request's comments.
How the run was started never matters, only such a comment. With a valid request the run proceeds as `"automatic"` would; a
request for an older head, from a reader or from a bot is ignored. A valid receipt is used whatever the setting, and a
repository in `required` mode keeps `local_receipt_required`. The receipt-only job still holds no provider secret: in manual
mode it returns `local_receipt_unusable` only when a valid request exists, so the reference workflow's hosted fallback below
starts exactly then, and the hosted job checks the request again. In the reference workflow (`examples/consumer-ci.yml`) a
`/hosted-review ` comment starts the reassessment the same way `/approve-intent ` does (the engine's `request-reassessment`
accepts an exact-head `/hosted-review` from a maintainer as it accepts `/approve-intent`); a consumer carrying an older copy adds

`|| startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/hosted-review ')` to its `request-reassessment` job condition.

#### Hosted review after an unusable receipt (reference consumer workflow)

A workflow that routes a PR whose description carries a receipt marker to a
`verify-local` job holds no provider credential in that job: the secret must not
be exposed to a job that runs on a contributor-supplied receipt. When that job finds
an optional-mode receipt unusable (decision `review_incomplete`, cause
`local_receipt_unusable`) the same run continues in a separate `assess-hosted` job
that holds the provider secrets. It runs `assess` with `ignore-receipt: 'true'`, so
the receipt is never read there, and it receives only the PR number and the frozen
engine, never an assessment, notice or record from the receipt-only job. Its
assessment and review record replace the receipt-only job's in `approve-and-merge`,

# Notices and their causes

Every refusal or hold that Clouseau shows on a pull request, in a check summary or in a workflow log carries three things:

1. a **cause class**, a fixed machine-stable name such as `receipt_engine` (the same text is used in the comment, the workflow annotation and this page);
2. one sentence that says what is wrong, with the concrete values that are safe to show: a short commit id, the engine revision, the base that moved, the rule that held, or a file of the pull request itself;
3. **numbered next steps** the customer can run, with exact commands where one exists.

A notice never contains a secret, the contents of a receipt, or a provider's response. A cause class is a key of a closed table in the source (`src/receipt-rejection.cjs`, `src/incomplete.cjs`, `src/gate-notice.cjs`, `src/merge-protection.cjs`, `src/branch-update.cjs`, `src/branch-conflict.cjs`); text from a run is never promoted to a class. `src/notice-causes.test.cjs` fails when a class is added without a sentence, a numbered step and a row on this page.

Commands in steps use `clouseau`, the global launcher of the shared agent installation (`bash scripts/install-agent`), and the GitHub CLI `gh`. `BASE_BRANCH`, `PR_NUMBER`, `REQUIREMENT_FILE` and `RECEIPT_FILE` are placeholders for values only you know.

## Local review receipt not used

A receipt named by the `clouseau-local-review:` marker in the pull request description is either verified in every respect or ignored. An ignored receipt approves nothing. What the run does next depends on the repository:

| Mode | What the notice says |
| --- | --- |
| Local review is required | Nothing is approved until you publish a valid receipt. Shown as an incomplete-review comment with cause `local_receipt_required`. |
| Receipt-only route (a marker is present, no provider key) | This run did not review the change itself. Publish a valid receipt, or remove the marker so the CI AI reviewer runs. Cause `local_receipt_unusable`. |
| Protected `hosted_review: "manual"`, with no maintainer request for this head | CI did not review the change. Publish a valid receipt, or a maintainer comments `/hosted-review <head sha>`. Cause `hosted_review_manual`. |
| Anything else | CI reviewed the change itself; no action is needed. A paragraph at the end of the review comment names the cause. |

The notice reads `Local review receipt not used (cause: \`receipt_<class>\`): <sentence>`, and the incomplete-review comment shows it as `**Cause:** \`local_receipt_required\` (\`receipt_<class>\`)`.

| Cause class | Meaning | First class-specific step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receipt_absent` | The pull request description carries no `clouseau-local-review:` marker. | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_unread` | This hosted run does not read receipts: it follows a receipt-only run, and that run already rejected the receipt (its notice names the cause). | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_malformed` | The marker or the published receipt is malformed or unsupported (for example more than one marker, an installation-only receipt, or an artifact that is not a Clouseau receipt). | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_unavailable` | The receipt could not be read from the immutable commit the marker names. | Check that the commit named by the marker still exists in this repository and has not been deleted; if it is gone, reissue the receipt. |
| `receipt_signature` | Its signature is not from an enrolled, active key. | Sign with an enrolled identity (`clouseau public-identity` prints the one on this machine); if it is not enrolled or was revoked, ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to enroll it. |
| `receipt_author` | Its signer is not enrolled for the author of this pull request. | Sign with an identity enrolled for the pull request author, or ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to enroll yours for this author. |
| `receipt_attestation` | It is not a maintainer attestation that the protected configuration permits for this pull request and author. | Have the pull request author run the review, or ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to allow `local_review.attest` for this author. |
| `receipt_expired` | It is expired or not yet valid. | Receipts are valid only for a limited time after they are issued; renew this one in the pull request checkout with `clouseau refresh --pr PR_NUMBER --agent claude\|codex\|opencode` (outside an AI harness use `--harness codex\|claude`), which reviews the unchanged head again, reusing the earlier answers, and replaces the marker without pushing the branch, or do the steps below by hand. |
| `receipt_revision_repository` | It was issued for a different repository. | Run the review in a checkout of this repository, not a fork or another project. |
| `receipt_revision_head` | It reviewed an earlier head but this pull request is now at another head. | Any push after a review needs a new review: make your last change first, then review and publish that head. |
| `receipt_revision_base` | It was issued against an earlier base but the base branch is now at a newer commit. | Update the branch with the base: `gh pr update-branch PR_NUMBER` (or `git fetch origin && git merge origin/BASE_BRANCH`; never rebase), then `git pull` if GitHub did it. |
| `receipt_changed` | The protected policy or configuration changed after the receipt was issued. | Merge the current base into the branch (`git fetch origin && git merge origin/BASE_BRANCH`; never rebase) so the review uses the current rules. |
| `receipt_source` | The reviewed sources or diff differ from the pull request. | The review reads committed files only: commit all changes, do not amend or add commits after the review, and make sure the pull request contains exactly the reviewed commits. |

| `receipt_record` | Its review record is incomplete or inconsistent with what was signed. | Do not edit a receipt by hand; discard it and run a fresh review. |
| `receipt_engine` | It was issued by an older Clouseau engine and this run uses the current protected engine, which does not list that engine as review-compatible. | Run the review again: the `clouseau` launcher refreshes to the current protected engine before it starts (pass `--engine latest` to leave a review that was started on an older engine). |
| `receipt_not_passing` | The review it records did not pass. | Open the findings of the local review, repair the blockers within the accepted requirement, and review the new head. |
| `receipt_settings` | The protected chunked review configuration is invalid, so no receipt can be checked. | This is not fixable from the pull request: ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch (the `chunked` settings), then re-run this check. |
| `receipt_untested` | No supplied test imports changed production code. An empty file (no nonblank line, such as an empty package `__init__.py`) holds no code and is never named. | Add or extend a test that imports each named production file (or the module that wraps it), commit it, and review again. A Rust file is tested by a change inside its own `#[cfg(test)]` test module (with `#[test]` functions) or by a `tests/` integration test that `use`s its module path; production lines changed beside an untouched test module are held, so add or extend a test in that module. |
| `receipt_integrity` | Test integrity is unresolved. | Make the tests prove the change (real assertions on the changed behavior, no weakened or deleted checks), commit, and review again. |
| `receipt_completeness` | Review completeness is unresolved. | Supply the evidence the reviewer could not read (sources or tests it names as missing), commit, and review again. |

Unless the class is `receipt_settings` (a protected configuration the owner must correct), the steps end with the same three that issue a fresh receipt for the current head by hand (`clouseau refresh --pr PR_NUMBER` does them for you; see [Refreshing a pull request](local-review.md#refreshing-a-pull-request-after-its-base-moved)):

1. Commit everything, then review this exact head: `clouseau review --directory . --base origin/BASE_BRANCH --request-file REQUIREMENT_FILE --agent claude|codex|opencode` (outside an AI harness use `--harness codex|claude` instead of `--agent`).
2. Publish the receipt: `clouseau publish --directory . --receipt RECEIPT_FILE`.
3. Put the marker it prints in the pull request description, replacing the old `clouseau-local-review:` marker (editing the description re-runs this check).

Values shown in a sentence are re-validated when rendered: commit ids must be 40 hexadecimal characters (shown as 12), an expiry must be an ISO instant, a branch name must be a plain name, and a file name comes from the pull request's own changed files with markup removed.

## Review incomplete

`Clouseau review incomplete` means no decision could be reached. The comment shows the cause class, one reason sentence and numbered steps. `{repo}` and `{run}` in a step are filled from the workflow run link.

| Cause class | First step |
| --- | --- |
| `provider_key_missing` | Add the provider key repository secret named in the reason: `gh secret set {secret} --repo {repo}`. |
| `provider_key_invalid` | Store the bare key (no spaces, quotation marks or line break) as the repository secret: `gh secret set {secret} --repo {repo}`. |
| `provider_rejected` | The provider refused the credential (HTTP 401 or 403). Create or activate a valid key in the provider console. |
| `provider_payment_required` | The provider refused the request for payment reasons (HTTP 402); the key itself was accepted. Add credit or fix billing on the provider account that owns the key. |
| `provider_unavailable` | No change to this pull request or its secrets is needed: the provider did not answer successfully. Check the provider status page. |
| `local_receipt_required` | Run the local Clouseau review on this exact head: `clouseau review --directory . --base origin/BASE_BRANCH --request-file REQUIREMENT_FILE --agent claude\|codex\|opencode`. |
| `local_receipt_unusable` | Run the local Clouseau review on this exact head and update the receipt marker in the pull request description (`clouseau review ...`, then `clouseau publish --directory . --receipt RECEIPT_FILE`). |
| `hosted_review_manual` | The repository's protected `hosted_review` is `"manual"` and no local review receipt can be used (the reason says why: absent, expired or another receipt class), so no CI AI review was started and no provider was called. Publish a valid receipt for this exact head, or a maintainer comments exactly `/hosted-review {head}` on this pull request to request the CI AI review of that head. If that comment starts no workflow run, the workflow's `issue_comment` condition lacks `/hosted-review `; the notice names the condition to add. |
| `review_output_invalid` | The reviewer model answered in an invalid form on every bounded attempt. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `provider_incomplete` | The reviewer model did not finish its answer within the bounded budget. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `evidence_budget` | Split the change so that the changed files together fit the 900 KB review evidence budget. |
| `changed_file_unreadable` | Split the file named in the reason out of this change, or make it complete text of at most 300 KB. |
| `lockfile_unsummarizable` | Regenerate the lockfile named in the reason with a supported lockfile version, or split it out of this change. |
| `changed_files_incomplete` | GitHub did not return a patch for every changed file (a very large, binary or truncated diff). Reduce the change so every file has a patch. |
| `tree_truncated` | The repository tree is too large to locate existing tests. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `investigation_exhausted` | The reviewer could not complete its bounded source investigation. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `verification_failed` | Open the failing job linked in the reason (when it names one) and fix the failing step. |
| `github_api_error` | GitHub rejected an API request this review needs; the status and endpoint are in the reason. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |

| Receipt-only route (a marker is present, no provider key) | This run did not review the change itself. Publish a valid receipt, or remove the marker so the CI AI reviewer runs. Cause `local_receipt_unusable`. |
| Anything else | CI reviewed the change itself; no action is needed. A paragraph at the end of the review comment names the cause. |

The notice reads `Local review receipt not used (cause: \`receipt_<class>\`): <sentence>`, and the incomplete-review comment shows it as `**Cause:** \`local_receipt_required\` (\`receipt_<class>\`)`.

| Cause class | Meaning | First class-specific step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receipt_absent` | The pull request description carries no `clouseau-local-review:` marker. | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_unread` | This hosted run does not read receipts: it follows a receipt-only run, and that run already rejected the receipt (its notice names the cause). | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_malformed` | The marker or the published receipt is malformed or unsupported (for example more than one marker, an installation-only receipt, or an artifact that is not a Clouseau receipt). | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_unavailable` | The receipt could not be read from the immutable commit the marker names. | Check that the commit named by the marker still exists in this repository and has not been deleted; if it is gone, reissue the receipt. |
| `receipt_signature` | Its signature is not from an enrolled, active key. | Sign with an enrolled identity (`clouseau public-identity` prints the one on this machine); if it is not enrolled or was revoked, ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to enroll it. |
| `receipt_author` | Its signer is not enrolled for the author of this pull request. | Sign with an identity enrolled for the pull request author, or ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to enroll yours for this author. |
| `receipt_attestation` | It is not a maintainer attestation that the protected configuration permits for this pull request and author. | Have the pull request author run the review, or ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to allow `local_review.attest` for this author. |
| `receipt_expired` | It is expired or not yet valid. | Receipts are valid only for a limited time after they are issued; renew this one in the pull request checkout with `clouseau refresh --pr PR_NUMBER --agent claude\|codex\|opencode` (outside an AI harness use `--harness codex\|claude`), which reviews the unchanged head again, reusing the earlier answers, and replaces the marker without pushing the branch, or do the steps below by hand. |
| `receipt_revision_repository` | It was issued for a different repository. | Run the review in a checkout of this repository, not a fork or another project. |
| `receipt_revision_head` | It reviewed an earlier head but this pull request is now at another head. | Any push after a review needs a new review: make your last change first, then review and publish that head. |
| `receipt_revision_base` | It was issued against an earlier base but the base branch is now at a newer commit. | Update the branch with the base: `gh pr update-branch PR_NUMBER` (or `git fetch origin && git merge origin/BASE_BRANCH`; never rebase), then `git pull` if GitHub did it. |
| `receipt_changed` | The protected policy or configuration changed after the receipt was issued. | Merge the current base into the branch (`git fetch origin && git merge origin/BASE_BRANCH`; never rebase) so the review uses the current rules. |
| `receipt_source` | The reviewed sources or diff differ from the pull request. | The review reads committed files only: commit all changes, do not amend or add commits after the review, and make sure the pull request contains exactly the reviewed commits. |
| `receipt_record` | Its review record is incomplete or inconsistent with what was signed. | Do not edit a receipt by hand; discard it and run a fresh review. |

# Clouseau

Clouseau also provides a centrally maintained local agent skill and signed review
receipts. Agent-only installation is independent of CI: it uses authenticated
coding harnesses and creates no Actions configuration or provider secrets.
Inside Claude Code, Codex or opencode the calling agent supplies the review
sessions (`--agent`); the headless `--harness` form is for a plain terminal.
Local AI review runs regardless of coverage percentage or availability and keeps
its quality verdict separate from real verification results. Opted-in CI verifies
an enrolled runner's passing AI receipt without repeating the review, then still
requires its own tests and exact coverage before approval/merge. See
[local review, installation and trust boundaries](docs/local-review.md).
New to Clouseau? Start with the [quickstart](docs/quickstart.md).
How a receipt stays valid across engine revisions: [receipt compatibility](docs/receipt-compatibility.md).
Every refusal or hold notice names its cause class and numbered next steps: [notices and their causes](docs/notices.md).
Consumers without accepted recipe/enrollment/workflows use the separate
[initial owner-authorized trust installation](docs/initial-installation.md).
Its signed evidence cannot approve ordinary changes or automatically merge.
Clouseau's own accepted-policy bootstrap and native coverage diagnostics are
documented in [self-review](docs/self-review.md).

Shared coverage gates and evidence-led AI pull request approval for GitHub Actions.
Clouseau owns the PR intent review process: check whether a change is needed,
compare it with repository contracts and precedent, request the owner's second
opinion when necessary, and approve and arm auto-merge only after every technical
requirement passes. The initial implementation was extracted from Colombo.

Version 2 implements the [change acceptance protocol](docs/change-acceptance.md):
product fit, need and proportionality; nine-factor technical findings; independent
source investigations; a persistent evidence ledger; bounded repairs; and native
protected auto-merge. Humans decide genuine purpose and authority questions.
Technical uncertainty goes to automated investigation and cannot be waived by
an intent comment. Version 1 remains explicit compatibility for existing pins.

## Ownership

Clouseau contains the coverage checker, regression tests, PR intent review rules,
DeepSeek integration, approval controller, and reusable composite action.
Each consuming repository keeps its build/test commands, a configuration file,
and its own purpose, contracts, acceptance criteria, and manual-review owner.

# Clouseau review contract

Clouseau provides shared, evidence-bound repository change assessment, exact
coverage gates, native PR approval and merge, and deployment-driven wiki updates.
Consumers provide their own protected purpose contract and verification steps.

Local agent review and authenticated receipt reuse serve the same change
acceptance purpose. Agent-only installation and refresh are independent of CI
installation. A protected verifier may reuse an enrolled runner's source-bound
passing review without another AI request, while preserving native tests, exact
coverage, existing owner authority and branch protection. Initial workstation
signing explicitly trusts the enrolled operator and privileged processes; it
does not claim hardware attestation or protection from a compromised runner.

Changes must preserve the trust boundary between untrusted contributor source,
secret-free execution checks, read-only AI evaluation and the separate write
controller. Native protected-main requirements, immutable revision identities,
meaningful tests and exact 100% line and branch coverage are mandatory.
Model text is data. It must never execute as a command or grant permissions.

An explicitly accepted manual-only integration must enforce branch protection
where GitHub makes it available and disable automatic merge for every author.
GitHub's documented private-plan protection limitation may permit independent
review and approval without host-enforced merge blocking, but never automatic
merge, waived tests, lowered coverage or omitted current-head owner approval for
external contributions. Missing credentials or generic API failures are not
evidence of that plan limitation. Report the enforcement boundary truthfully.

Useful defect repairs, meaningful tests, provider qualification and maintenance
serve this purpose without a new product decision. Speculative frameworks,
unrelated capabilities or additional authority require concrete justification.
The shared protocol defines product and technical scoring; no owner intent
confirmation waives integrity failures, incomplete evidence or technical defects.

Changes to the reviewer implementation, scoring policy, verification controls or
this purpose contract require explicit exact-revision confirmation from gaulatti.
Only real purpose, authority and outcome tradeoffs are sent to the owner. A
missing provider response or unresolved code concern belongs to automated
investigation or bounded repair, never automatic approval.

Two more classes are only ever shown when no receipt can be used at all:

an unstamped change (the pending or blocked result carries the notice).

#### Manual hosted review (opt-in)

The protected top-level `hosted_review` in `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch says whether the CI AI review of a pull
request with no usable receipt starts by itself:

| `hosted_review` | No usable receipt (absent, expired or otherwise unusable) |
| --- | --- |
| absent or `"automatic"` | today's behavior: the CI AI review runs (optional mode), or `local_receipt_required` (required mode) |
| `"manual"` | `review_incomplete`, cause `hosted_review_manual`, no provider call, until a maintainer requests the review |

        with:
          script: |
            core.setOutput('local', String((context.payload.pull_request?.body || '').includes('clouseau-local-review:v1')));
      - name: Verify authenticated local review without AI credentials
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local == 'true'

          operation: verify-local
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
      - name: Hand an unusable receipt to the separate hosted review
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local == 'true'
        id: fallback
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          ASSESSMENT: ${{ steps.local-review.outputs.assessment }}
        with:
          script: |
            const assessment = JSON.parse(process.env.ASSESSMENT);
            core.setOutput('hosted', String(assessment.decision === 'review_incomplete' && assessment.cause === 'local_receipt_unusable'));
      - name: Review unstamped PR through the installed CI AI reviewer
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local != 'true'
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        id: assess
        with:
          operation: assess
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
          provider-key: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          typesafe-key: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}

A workflow that routes a PR whose description carries a receipt marker to a

# Notices and their causes

Every refusal or hold that Clouseau shows on a pull request, in a check summary or in a workflow log carries three things:

1. a **cause class**, a fixed machine-stable name such as `receipt_engine` (the same text is used in the comment, the workflow annotation and this page);
2. one sentence that says what is wrong, with the concrete values that are safe to show: a short commit id, the engine revision, the base that moved, the rule that held, or a file of the pull request itself;
3. **numbered next steps** the customer can run, with exact commands where one exists.

A notice never contains a secret, the contents of a receipt, or a provider's response. A cause class is a key of a closed table in the source (`src/receipt-rejection.cjs`, `src/incomplete.cjs`, `src/gate-notice.cjs`, `src/merge-protection.cjs`, `src/branch-update.cjs`, `src/branch-conflict.cjs`); text from a run is never promoted to a class. `src/notice-causes.test.cjs` fails when a class is added without a sentence, a numbered step and a row on this page.

Commands in steps use `clouseau`, the global launcher of the shared agent installation (`bash scripts/install-agent`), and the GitHub CLI `gh`. `BASE_BRANCH`, `PR_NUMBER`, `REQUIREMENT_FILE` and `RECEIPT_FILE` are placeholders for values only you know.

## Local review receipt not used

A receipt named by the `clouseau-local-review:` marker in the pull request description is either verified in every respect or ignored. An ignored receipt approves nothing. What the run does next depends on the repository:

| Mode | What the notice says |
| --- | --- |
| Local review is required | Nothing is approved until you publish a valid receipt. Shown as an incomplete-review comment with cause `local_receipt_required`. |
| Receipt-only route (a marker is present, no provider key) | This run did not review the change itself. Publish a valid receipt, or remove the marker so the CI AI reviewer runs. Cause `local_receipt_unusable`. |
| Protected `hosted_review: "manual"`, with no maintainer request for this head | CI did not review the change. Publish a valid receipt, or a maintainer comments `/hosted-review <head sha>`. Cause `hosted_review_manual`. |
| Anything else | CI reviewed the change itself; no action is needed. A paragraph at the end of the review comment names the cause. |

The notice reads `Local review receipt not used (cause: \`receipt_<class>\`): <sentence>`, and the incomplete-review comment shows it as `**Cause:** \`local_receipt_required\` (\`receipt_<class>\`)`.

| Cause class | Meaning | First class-specific step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `receipt_absent` | The pull request description carries no `clouseau-local-review:` marker. | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_unread` | This hosted run does not read receipts: it follows a receipt-only run, and that run already rejected the receipt (its notice names the cause). | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_malformed` | The marker or the published receipt is malformed or unsupported (for example more than one marker, an installation-only receipt, or an artifact that is not a Clouseau receipt). | Reissue the receipt (below). |
| `receipt_unavailable` | The receipt could not be read from the immutable commit the marker names. | Check that the commit named by the marker still exists in this repository and has not been deleted; if it is gone, reissue the receipt. |
| `receipt_signature` | Its signature is not from an enrolled, active key. | Sign with an enrolled identity (`clouseau public-identity` prints the one on this machine); if it is not enrolled or was revoked, ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to enroll it. |
| `receipt_author` | Its signer is not enrolled for the author of this pull request. | Sign with an identity enrolled for the pull request author, or ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to enroll yours for this author. |
| `receipt_attestation` | It is not a maintainer attestation that the protected configuration permits for this pull request and author. | Have the pull request author run the review, or ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch to allow `local_review.attest` for this author. |
| `receipt_expired` | It is expired or not yet valid. | Receipts are valid only for a limited time after they are issued; renew this one in the pull request checkout with `clouseau refresh --pr PR_NUMBER --agent claude\|codex\|opencode` (outside an AI harness use `--harness codex\|claude`), which reviews the unchanged head again, reusing the earlier answers, and replaces the marker without pushing the branch, or do the steps below by hand. |
| `receipt_revision_repository` | It was issued for a different repository. | Run the review in a checkout of this repository, not a fork or another project. |
| `receipt_revision_head` | It reviewed an earlier head but this pull request is now at another head. | Any push after a review needs a new review: make your last change first, then review and publish that head. |
| `receipt_revision_base` | It was issued against an earlier base but the base branch is now at a newer commit. | Update the branch with the base: `gh pr update-branch PR_NUMBER` (or `git fetch origin && git merge origin/BASE_BRANCH`; never rebase), then `git pull` if GitHub did it. |
| `receipt_changed` | The protected policy or configuration changed after the receipt was issued. | Merge the current base into the branch (`git fetch origin && git merge origin/BASE_BRANCH`; never rebase) so the review uses the current rules. |
| `receipt_source` | The reviewed sources or diff differ from the pull request. | The review reads committed files only: commit all changes, do not amend or add commits after the review, and make sure the pull request contains exactly the reviewed commits. |

| `receipt_record` | Its review record is incomplete or inconsistent with what was signed. | Do not edit a receipt by hand; discard it and run a fresh review. |
| `receipt_engine` | It was issued by an older Clouseau engine and this run uses the current protected engine, which does not list that engine as review-compatible. | Run the review again: the `clouseau` launcher refreshes to the current protected engine before it starts (pass `--engine latest` to leave a review that was started on an older engine). |
| `receipt_not_passing` | The review it records did not pass. | Open the findings of the local review, repair the blockers within the accepted requirement, and review the new head. |
| `receipt_settings` | The protected chunked review configuration is invalid, so no receipt can be checked. | This is not fixable from the pull request: ask a repository owner to change the protected `local_review` section of `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch (the `chunked` settings), then re-run this check. |
| `receipt_untested` | No supplied test imports changed production code. An empty file (no nonblank line, such as an empty package `__init__.py`) holds no code and is never named. | Add or extend a test that imports each named production file (or the module that wraps it), commit it, and review again. A Rust file is tested by a change inside its own `#[cfg(test)]` test module (with `#[test]` functions) or by a `tests/` integration test that `use`s its module path; production lines changed beside an untouched test module are held, so add or extend a test in that module. |
| `receipt_integrity` | Test integrity is unresolved. | Make the tests prove the change (real assertions on the changed behavior, no weakened or deleted checks), commit, and review again. |
| `receipt_completeness` | Review completeness is unresolved. | Supply the evidence the reviewer could not read (sources or tests it names as missing), commit, and review again. |

Unless the class is `receipt_settings` (a protected configuration the owner must correct), the steps end with the same three that issue a fresh receipt for the current head by hand (`clouseau refresh --pr PR_NUMBER` does them for you; see [Refreshing a pull request](local-review.md#refreshing-a-pull-request-after-its-base-moved)):

1. Commit everything, then review this exact head: `clouseau review --directory . --base origin/BASE_BRANCH --request-file REQUIREMENT_FILE --agent claude|codex|opencode` (outside an AI harness use `--harness codex|claude` instead of `--agent`).
2. Publish the receipt: `clouseau publish --directory . --receipt RECEIPT_FILE`.
3. Put the marker it prints in the pull request description, replacing the old `clouseau-local-review:` marker (editing the description re-runs this check).

Values shown in a sentence are re-validated when rendered: commit ids must be 40 hexadecimal characters (shown as 12), an expiry must be an ISO instant, a branch name must be a plain name, and a file name comes from the pull request's own changed files with markup removed.

## Review incomplete

`Clouseau review incomplete` means no decision could be reached. The comment shows the cause class, one reason sentence and numbered steps. `{repo}` and `{run}` in a step are filled from the workflow run link.

| Cause class | First step |
| --- | --- |
| `provider_key_missing` | Add the provider key repository secret named in the reason: `gh secret set {secret} --repo {repo}`. |
| `provider_key_invalid` | Store the bare key (no spaces, quotation marks or line break) as the repository secret: `gh secret set {secret} --repo {repo}`. |
| `provider_rejected` | The provider refused the credential (HTTP 401 or 403). Create or activate a valid key in the provider console. |
| `provider_payment_required` | The provider refused the request for payment reasons (HTTP 402); the key itself was accepted. Add credit or fix billing on the provider account that owns the key. |
| `provider_unavailable` | No change to this pull request or its secrets is needed: the provider did not answer successfully. Check the provider status page. |
| `local_receipt_required` | Run the local Clouseau review on this exact head: `clouseau review --directory . --base origin/BASE_BRANCH --request-file REQUIREMENT_FILE --agent claude\|codex\|opencode`. |
| `local_receipt_unusable` | Run the local Clouseau review on this exact head and update the receipt marker in the pull request description (`clouseau review ...`, then `clouseau publish --directory . --receipt RECEIPT_FILE`). |
| `hosted_review_manual` | The repository's protected `hosted_review` is `"manual"` and no local review receipt can be used (the reason says why: absent, expired or another receipt class), so no CI AI review was started and no provider was called. Publish a valid receipt for this exact head, or a maintainer comments exactly `/hosted-review {head}` on this pull request to request the CI AI review of that head. If that comment starts no workflow run, the workflow's `issue_comment` condition lacks `/hosted-review `; the notice names the condition to add. |
| `review_output_invalid` | The reviewer model answered in an invalid form on every bounded attempt. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `provider_incomplete` | The reviewer model did not finish its answer within the bounded budget. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `evidence_budget` | Split the change so that the changed files together fit the 900 KB review evidence budget. |
| `changed_file_unreadable` | Split the file named in the reason out of this change, or make it complete text of at most 300 KB. |
| `lockfile_unsummarizable` | Regenerate the lockfile named in the reason with a supported lockfile version, or split it out of this change. |
| `changed_files_incomplete` | GitHub did not return a patch for every changed file (a very large, binary or truncated diff). Reduce the change so every file has a patch. |
| `tree_truncated` | The repository tree is too large to locate existing tests. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `investigation_exhausted` | The reviewer could not complete its bounded source investigation. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |
| `verification_failed` | Open the failing job linked in the reason (when it names one) and fix the failing step. |
| `github_api_error` | GitHub rejected an API request this review needs; the status and endpoint are in the reason. Re-run only the failed jobs: `gh run rerun {run} --failed --repo {repo}`. |

# Clouseau

Clouseau also provides a centrally maintained local agent skill and signed review
receipts. Agent-only installation is independent of CI: it uses authenticated
coding harnesses and creates no Actions configuration or provider secrets.
Inside Claude Code, Codex or opencode the calling agent supplies the review
sessions (`--agent`); the headless `--harness` form is for a plain terminal.
Local AI review runs regardless of coverage percentage or availability and keeps
its quality verdict separate from real verification results. Opted-in CI verifies
an enrolled runner's passing AI receipt without repeating the review, then still
requires its own tests and exact coverage before approval/merge. See
[local review, installation and trust boundaries](docs/local-review.md).
New to Clouseau? Start with the [quickstart](docs/quickstart.md).
How a receipt stays valid across engine revisions: [receipt compatibility](docs/receipt-compatibility.md).
Every refusal or hold notice names its cause class and numbered next steps: [notices and their causes](docs/notices.md).
Consumers without accepted recipe/enrollment/workflows use the separate
[initial owner-authorized trust installation](docs/initial-installation.md).
Its signed evidence cannot approve ordinary changes or automatically merge.
Clouseau's own accepted-policy bootstrap and native coverage diagnostics are
documented in [self-review](docs/self-review.md).

Shared coverage gates and evidence-led AI pull request approval for GitHub Actions.
Clouseau owns the PR intent review process: check whether a change is needed,
compare it with repository contracts and precedent, request the owner's second
opinion when necessary, and approve and arm auto-merge only after every technical
requirement passes. The initial implementation was extracted from Colombo.

Version 2 implements the [change acceptance protocol](docs/change-acceptance.md):
product fit, need and proportionality; nine-factor technical findings; independent
source investigations; a persistent evidence ledger; bounded repairs; and native
protected auto-merge. Humans decide genuine purpose and authority questions.
Technical uncertainty goes to automated investigation and cannot be waived by
an intent comment. Version 1 remains explicit compatibility for existing pins.

## Ownership

Clouseau contains the coverage checker, regression tests, PR intent review rules,
DeepSeek integration, approval controller, and reusable composite action.
Each consuming repository keeps its build/test commands, a configuration file,
and its own purpose, contracts, acceptance criteria, and manual-review owner.
